```{r}
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# 
# | Soil Reflectance Indices               |
# | Concept             | Index idea                    | Soil meaning                 |
# | ------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
# | Brightness          | `(R + G + B) / 3`             | Surface albedo, texture, SOM |
# | Redness             | `R / (R + G)`                 | Iron oxides                  |
# | Iron vs OM          | `Red / NIR`                   | Fe vs carbon darkening       |
# | Soil color contrast | `(Red − Green)/(Red + Green)` | Hue differences              |
# | Clay proxy          | `RedEdge / NIR`               | Mineral absorption features  |


# 
# BI_rgb_mean / BI_rgb_root: “surface brightness/albedo proxy” (texture + OM + moisture history signals)
# 
# RI / RGRI / IOI_RB: “redness / iron oxide expression” proxies
# 
# VARI: “visible index designed to reduce illumination sensitivity”
# 
# NDRE / RE_NIR: “red-edge/NIR contrast (material/edge behavior), useful even in sparse vegetation or mixed bare soil conditions” (and it’s a standard red-edge form)
# Red/Blue iron oxide ratio is a widely used proxy for iron oxide expression (blue absorption + red reflectance).
# 
# Redness Index and related RGB color indices (brightness, hue-ish metrics) are commonly used in soil/earth observation contexts.
# 
# VARI is a standard “visible” index designed to be more robust to illumination effects than raw bands.
# 


#load dataL:

covariate_stack_SR <- rast("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m.tif")

#select SR bands only:
SR_bands <- covariate_stack_SR[[c("red", "green", "blue", "rededge", "nir","coastal_blue","yellow","green_i")]]

# -----------------------------
# 0) Optional: rescale SR to 0–1 if it looks like 0–10000 scaled integers
#    (Planet SR is often scaled; check range quickly)
# -----------------------------
sr_minmax <- global(SR_bands, fun = range, na.rm = TRUE)
print(sr_minmax)

# If max is > 2-ish, it’s almost certainly scaled ints; convert to 0–1
if (max(sr_minmax, na.rm = TRUE) > 2) {
  SR <- SR_bands / 10000
} else {
  SR <- SR_bands
}

# -----------------------------
# 1) Helpers
# -----------------------------
eps <- 1e-6
safe_div <- function(num, den) num / (den + eps)

R  <- SR[["red"]]
G  <- SR[["green"]]
B  <- SR[["blue"]]
RE <- SR[["rededge"]]
N  <- SR[["nir"]]
CB <- SR[["coastal_blue"]]
Y  <- SR[["yellow"]]
GI <- SR[["green_i"]]

SUM_RGB <- R + G + B + eps

# -----------------------------
# 2) Indices (soil-interpretable)
# -----------------------------
idx <- c(
  # Brightness / albedo proxies
  BI_rgb_mean  = (R + G + B) / 3,                           # “brightness”
  BI_rgb_root  = sqrt((R^2 + G^2 + B^2) / 3),               # brightness index variant

  # Normalized color components (help separate hue vs illumination)
  NR = safe_div(R, SUM_RGB),
  NG = safe_div(G, SUM_RGB),
  NB = safe_div(B, SUM_RGB),

  # Redness / color contrast (iron oxide / hue-ish behavior)
  RI      = safe_div(R - G, R + G),                         # Redness Index (R,G)
  RGRI    = safe_div(R, G),                                 # Red/Green ratio

  # Iron oxide expression proxy (classic)
  IOI_RB  = safe_div(R, B),                                 # Iron Oxide Index/Ratio ~ Red/Blue

  # Visible “illumination-robust” color
  VARI    = safe_div(G - R, (G + R - B)),                   # Visible Atmospherically Resistant Index

  # Red-edge contrast (often tracks pigment edge / subtle material shifts)
  NDRE    = safe_div(N - RE, N + RE),                       # NIR vs RedEdge contrast
  RE_NIR  = safe_div(RE, N),                                # simple ratio

  # Bare-soil “blueing” vs redness (sometimes tracks OM darkening / haze effects)
  RB_norm = safe_div(R - B, R + B),                         # normalized red-blue contrast
  CB_ratio = safe_div(CB, B),                               # coastal-blue relative to blue (atmosphere/scatter-ish)

  # Yellow and GreenI contrasts (can behave like “yellowing” / slope of visible)
  YR_norm  = safe_div(Y - R, Y + R),
  GI_G_norm = safe_div(GI - G, GI + G)
)

names(idx) <- names(idx)  # keep names stable

# Optional: drop any extreme junk values (rare but can happen with eps + tiny denominators)
idx <- terra::rast(idx)
idx <- idx * 1  # force SpatRaster evaluation

for (i in seq_len(nlyr(idx))) {
  idx[[i]] <- terra::clamp(idx[[i]], lower = -5, upper = 5, values = TRUE)
}

# -----------------------------
# 3) Output: stack of indices you can append to covariate_stack
# -----------------------------
SR_indices <- idx
print(SR_indices)
names(SR_indices)

plot(SR_indices)
```

```{r}  
#merge back with covariate stack
cov_no_rawSR <- covariate_stack_SR[[setdiff(names(covariate_stack_SR), names(SR_bands))]]
covariate_stack_idx <- c(cov_no_rawSR, SR_indices)

#all together: 
covariate_stack_SR_all <- c(covariate_stack_SR, SR_indices)
#save stack:
#writeRaster(covariate_stack_idx, "../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m_with_SR_indices.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
writeRaster(covariate_stack_SR_all, "../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/covariate_stack/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
```
